title: APG window splitter
text: Focusable separators with values, arrow keys, Home and End, and Enter to collapse.

title: Pixels or percent
text: Initial, minimum, and maximum sizes in pixels or percentages, kept on resize.

title: Collapsible panes
text: Collapse with Enter or by dragging past half the minimum; restore to the previous size.

title: Nested and RTL
text: Horizontal and vertical splitters nest; horizontal ones mirror in right-to-left layouts.

title: You own persistence
text: aui-change reports the sizes; pass them back as sizes. Nothing is stored by the component.
